notes:
Summary: MidCrest is a mid-market SaaS (B2B search/product discovery) building a relevance layer on top of their existing vector/keyword pipeline. They started with Hosted API to iterate quickly; evaluation now focused on whether Dedicated capacity makes sense for predictable latency, cost and private network egress. Key ask: a rerank endpoint that accepts 8–50 candidate documents and returns a ranked list with feature explainability for A/B analysis.

Key constraints / asks (from PM & Eng):
- Latency targets: p95 < 250ms for single rerank calls (10–20 candidates), p99 < 400ms during normal load.
- Throughput: baseline 40 qps (spiky to 120 qps during feature release windows).
- Offline scoring: need batch offline rerank runner to score 50k candidates nightly for eval pipeline.
- Eval / metrics: want NDCG, MRR and pairwise loss; will run Redwood-provided eval harness against baseline BM25.
- Model preferences: prefer open models (Llama-like family) with quantized variants; want ability to fall back to a smaller model for non-critical traffic.
- Cost sensitivity: engineering lead said "We need predictable unit economics — our product margin is tight." CFO asked for sample 6/12/24-month burn sims.

POC specifics and findings so far:
- Hosted demo improved offline NDCG by ~9–12% vs BM25 on their sample eval set (50k). PM happy with quality uplift.
- Latency on Hosted API meets p95 in quiet tests (~180ms) but spikes under realistic workload; investigating batching and KV cache policies.
- Offline scoring prototype (using SDK + batch job) completed; initial run processed 50k queries in ~2.5 hours — acceptable but want faster nightly cadence.
- Security: they require SSO (SAML) + audit logs for any dedicated/private deployment. Legal requested SOC2 attestation and copy of retention controls.

Quotes & call snippets:
- "If we can get consistent p95 at <250ms and predictable per-unit cost, Dedicated is attractive." — Product Lead (M. Alvarez)
- "We need to be able to run offline reranking at scale for nightly re-evals; can't have opaque model changes without eval guardrails." — Eng Manager (S. Patel)

Open items / asks from AE/SE to Redwood:

- Sample Dedicated pool pricing with burst options and 12-month commit scenarios (include unit economics vs Hosted).
- Help tune batching and cache settings for p99 improvements; provide recommended model variants for cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Confirm support for offline scoring API or guidance for running a nightly scorer (examples + SDK snippets).
